description: This file defines the CoreGraphicsPath class, a part of the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, representing a graphics path with methods for drawing shapes, curves, and handling path points in a GDI+ compatible notation. It includes methods for moving, drawing lines, Bezier curves, arcs, and subpath management.

classes.name: CoreGraphicsPath
classes.description: Represents a graphics path aligned with GDI+ notation, supporting path operations such as move, line, Bézier curves, arcs, and subpath management.

methods.name: MoveOrLineTo
methods.description: Adds a move or line command based on the current path state.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.description: Starts a new subpath at the given coordinates.

methods.name: LineTo
methods.description: Adds a line to the specified point, optionally closing the subpath.

methods.name: BezierTo
methods.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve segment with control points and endpoint.

methods.name: QuadrantArcTo
methods.description: Adds an arc filling one quadrant of an ellipse, approximated using Bézier curves.

methods.name: AddArc
methods.description: Adds an arc in the shape of an ellipse segment to the path.

methods.name: AddArc (overload)
methods.description: Adds an arc specified by two points, size, rotation, and sweep direction.

methods.name: AddCurve
methods.description: Adds a spline curve passing through a set of points with specified tension.

methods.name: ToCurveSegment
methods.description: Calculates Bézier control points for a segment of a spline curve.
